chronology.entry_evidence: yes_bid close up-cross from below 78 to at or above 78
chronology.unproven_first: first valid close already at or above 78 with no earlier valid close below 78
chronology.intrabar_low: a low at or below 67 inside the entry bar is INTRABAR_AMBIGUITY. It does not reject the close-trigger entry and is not a stop.
chronology.baseline_stop: first strictly later valid close at or below 67
chronology.clocks: MODELED_AVAILABILITY. NBA walls are retrospective interpolation, not receive-time proof.
chronology.ncaab_boundary: Reference code: H1 remaining <= 600 is H1_2; H2 remaining > 600 is H2_1; H2 remaining == 600 is H2_2. The v1 prose that assigns the 600-second boundary to the first ten minutes is not the rule.

stop_failure.key: seed and ex-ante candidate instance id, before outcomes
stop_failure.on_failure: The modeled 67 cent sale does not occur. The position holds to the recorded settlement if that settlement timestamp is at or after entry. If settlement is missing, the holding stays unresolved and the slot stays occupied.
stop_failure.oracle_tail: separate module, unavailable to baseline scenario ids
